async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill in the group creation form on the current page
    # Assuming textboxes for group name and group URL are present with standard roles
    group_name = "coding_friends"
    group_url = "coding-friends"  # Using a URL slug based on the group name
    description = ""  # No description provided

    # Fill group name textbox
    group_name_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Group name", exact=False)
    await group_name_input.fill(group_name)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Fill group URL textbox
    group_url_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Group URL", exact=False)
    await group_url_input.fill(group_url)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Fill description textbox if present (optional)
    try:
        description_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description", exact=False)
        await description_input.fill(description)
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except:
        pass  # Description field might not be required or present

    # Step 2: Click the 'Create group' button to submit the form
    create_group_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create group", exact=False)
    await create_group_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 3: After group creation, navigate to the group's members page
    # Assuming the group page loads and has a link to 'Members'
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members", exact=False)
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 4: Add members qhduan and Agnes-U
    # Find the input for adding members and the add button
    add_member_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Add members", exact=False)
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add", exact=False)

    # Add first member
    await add_member_input.fill("qhduan")
    await add_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Add second member
    await add_member_input.fill("Agnes-U")
    await add_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Step 5: Wait briefly to ensure all actions are processed
    import asyncio
    await asyncio.sleep(2)

    # No further actions needed; the task should be complete
    return "Group 'coding_friends' created with members qhduan and Agnes-U."
